Pentagon Probes China's Possession of F-35 Jet Parts

The Pentagon is investigating how components intended for the F-35 stealth fighter jet ended up in China. The parts, including a cockpit canopy and weapons-bay door, were shipped from Australia to the U.S. via UPS but were diverted to Hong Kong. Chinese authorities have reportedly taken possession of these sensitive F-35 components.
